purpose: Machine source-of-truth for which libavfilter capabilities the Qianqian AudioEngine DSP envelope needs. Frozen decision: AudioEngine DSP = capability-trimmed libavfilter; SRC = aresample/libswresample. Humans edit intent here; machines derive source closures. Never hand-edit derived manifests.

canonical_pcm.note: Qianqian's graph input is abuffer(flt, source rate/layout); every deviation (fltp/dbl/dblp/resample) is a graph-inserted conversion that must be reported, not hidden in filter cost

format_adaptation.discovery_model: Per stage/probe: (A) build codec(+F0)+target filters with ONLY configure-required dependencies, parsed from the pinned configure's <filter>_filter_deps rules (machine-derived, authoritative); (B) instantiate the actual representative graph on canonical flt/interleaved/source-rate input; (C) on success record the negotiated format and graph-auto-inserted converters; (D) on graph-config failure add the minimal format-adaptation capability (aresample, which configure-requires swresample) and rebuild. Direct closure and effective usable closure are both recorded; the adaptation cost is reported separately from the filter's direct cost.

aresample.role: the minimal graph format-adaptation capability; never pre-enabled by capability intent

format_adaptation.note: Capability intent declares DESIRED FILTERS ONLY. Hidden dependency answers are machine discoveries, not human table rows.

tiers.name: framework-minimum
tiers.question: entry cost of having a usable audio filter graph at all (no format adaptation)

product_capabilities.meaning: abuffer/abuffersink endpoints, anull passthrough, aformat constraint node

tiers.name: core-gain-eq-tone
tiers.question: cost of the core player DSP vocabulary (gain, parametric/graphic EQ, tone, shelves, filters)

raw biquad coefficients for product-owned designs

tiers.relations: bass/treble/lowshelf/highshelf/equalizer/biquad/lowpass/highpass all live in one biquad-class TU (af_biquad.c) in the pinned tree; relations are recorded, product semantics are NOT collapsed

tiers.name: dynamics
tiers.question: cost of compressor/limiter/gate and their hidden format requirements

product_capabilities.meaning: noise gate, kept only if cheap/useful

tiers.name: stereo-channel

product_capabilities.meaning: one pan filter covers gain-per-channel rematrixing incl. downmix

tiers.configure_notes: pan_filter_deps=swresample (pinned configure:4241) - pan is configure-required swr regardless of format adaptation

tiers.name: classic-effects
tiers.question: marginal cost of the whole classic player effects group and its largest individual drivers

product_capabilities.meaning: metadata -> scalar -> volume filter (product-owned control value); the FFmpeg replaygain filter is NOT enabled

tiers.name: advanced-correction

product_capabilities.meaning: atempo; does NOT answer the general SRC question (separate decision)
